gauge_scope_result.independent_positive_affine_unaligned: not identifiable; naive mean semantic error ~0.71
gauge_scope_result.strict_monotone: weighted mean rejected without geometry grounding
gauge_scope_result.one_parameter_monotone_plus_one_interior: weighted mean restored; mean semantic error ~2.4e-5

open_world_validation.design: input gauge is a persistent latent nuisance. A selected semantic source is rejected only if every plausible gauge hypothesis fails independent target-native heldout behavioral stress tests.

routing_budget_and_instance_result.interpretation: the earlier source-5 abstention was a 24-query budget cutoff, not evidence that hierarchical instance routing was required. Do not enable extra hierarchy by default when adaptive query budget is sufficient.

facts: Gauge group alone is insufficient for fusion capability; gauge scope/coupling across plugin outputs matters.
Closed-world source routing is not an OOD detector, even when routing posterior is high.

Persistent nuisance variables should be retained through sequential evidence rather than averaged query-wise; this holds for both model-instance style in earlier experiments and input gauge in the current V2 screen.

After a common affine chart is grounded, exact 0.5/0.5 fusion is stable in this controlled neural scalar setting. The earlier V1 near-tie collapse is therefore not a universal gauge-impossibility result.
boundaries: Positive private-input result still uses a known finite D4 gauge family.
Neural sources are small controlled regressors, not unrelated pretrained foundation models.
Open-world thresholds are empirically calibrated on heldout in-family instances; formal finite-sample guarantees remain open.
Fusion is scalar transition-output mixing after explicit chart alignment, not arbitrary hidden-state or weight-space fusion.
next: Replace finite D4 input-gauge enumeration with learned or continuous gauge proposals while keeping existential open-world validation.
Repeat gauge-scope and open-world validation with heterogeneous architectures and stochastic token outputs.
Infer the admissible composition algebra from behavior instead of hand-declaring gauge capabilities.
Revisit the old V1 latent transition representation with explicit chart geometry to isolate the cause of 0.5/0.5 collapse.
